Welcome to the HiTOP Digital Assessment and Tracker (HiTOP-DAT) resources page. The HiTOP-DAT is a battery of 382 items from seven published measures: the WHODAS, IDAS-II, AUDIT, DUDIT, CAPE, CAT-PD and PHQ-15. Here you can download printable Word forms and Qualtrics and REDCap import files. Each form gives each measure's instructions, where it has them, before its first item and shows each item with its own response options. The `hitop` package does not score the HiTOP-DAT yet.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_download-helpers.R")
```

```{=html}
<h3 class="mt-4 mb-3">Ready-to-Use Downloads</h3>
<p class="text-muted">Choose the format that best fits your immediate research needs.</p>
```

```{r downloads, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
download_cards("HiTOP-DAT", list(
  dl_card(
    "📄", "Printable Document",
    "Use these Microsoft Word documents for printing, paper administration, or sending to the IRB.",
    dl_link("English (A4 Paper)", "../downloads/hitopdat_A4.docx"),
    dl_link("English (US Paper)", "../downloads/hitopdat_US.docx")
  ),
  dl_card(
    "📊", "Qualtrics Import",
    "Use this specially formatted text file to import the battery directly into your Qualtrics surveys.",
    dl_link("English (TXT File)", "../downloads/hitopdat_qualtrics.txt"),
    ref_link("Import Instructions", "../articles/import-instructions.html#qualtrics-txt")
  ),
  dl_card(
    "🏥", "REDCap Import",
    "Use this compressed archive file to import the battery as a new instrument in your REDCap project.",
    dl_link("English (ZIP File)", "../downloads/hitopdat_redcap.zip"),
    ref_link("Import Instructions", "../articles/import-instructions.html#redcap-zip")
  )
))
```
